against_threshold.purpose: Identify gross miscalibration, NOT to establish general predictive skill. A result of K < 4 does NOT establish that the model is skilled or validated.

assumptions.dependence_model: Exchangeable Gaussian copula: Y_i = 1[X_i <= Phi^{-1}(p_i)] where X ~ N(0, Sigma) with Sigma_ij = rho for i!=j, Sigma_ii = 1. This bounds the worst-case inflation of P(K>=4) under positive dependence, which is the direction that makes K>=4 easier to trigger spuriously.
assumptions.independence_assumption: The Monte Carlo construction assumes pool-level independence (each pool draws its own seed from sha256(GLOBAL_RANDOM_SEED:record_id)). This is a MODEL ASSUMPTION, not an empirical observation.
assumptions.rho_sensitivity: The rho in [0, 0.8] range is a CONSERVATIVE sensitivity check: if the independence assumption is violated and pairwise correlation is as high as 0.8, P(K>=4) rises to at most 0.0449 - still within the 5% level.
assumptions.what_is_not_measured: The model does NOT measure the true 14-day horizon correlation structure. Pre-genesis daily XRP-token price data showed rho_bar ~ -0.008 (previously reported, with bootstrap interval). Daily correlation is NOT a measurement of 14-day correlation.

statistical_validation_rho_sensitivity.model: Gaussian copula with exchangeable pairwise correlation rho (rho in [0, 0.8])
statistical_validation_rho_sensitivity.note: The 12 pools with y_prob=0 contribute deterministically to K=0 (never trap). The trap count K is a Poisson-Binomial over the 6 non-zero pools at rho=0, and a Gaussian-copula Poisson-Binomial over all 18 pools for rho>0.

concentration_disclosure.explanation: The limitation is predictive-information concentration rather than simply pool count. 12 of 18 pools carry y_prob = 0 (structurally uninformative), and the 6 informative pools concentrate in 1/HHI = 2.83 effective pools. One pool (STX) alone contributes 49.31% of E; the top two contribute 80.01%. The cohort's joint distribution is governed by these few heavy contributors, not by the nominal 18.
concentration_disclosure.no_skill_conversion: This concentration is a structural feature of the prediction set, not a performance result. Concentrated predictions cannot be 'rescued' by a favorable outcome - the SKILL tier is structurally unavailable regardless.

assumed.model_assumption: The prediction model's Monte Carlo construction assumes pool-level independence: each pool draws its own seed from sha256(GLOBAL_RANDOM_SEED:record_id), so the 18 simulations are independent while the real pools share one market tape.
assumed.not_an_observation: This is a MODEL ASSUMPTION, not an empirical observation.
assumed.open_assumption: The 14-day correlation structure is an explicit open assumption/limitation. The rho in [0, 0.8] sensitivity range is a CONSERVATIVE CHECK on this assumption.

maturity_ts.note: This standard is a PRE-OUTCOME acceptance standard, not a verdict artifact. It contains neither 'verdict' in its artifact type nor a verdict tier, so prereg_commit.maturity_check()'s verdict-family filter does not select it - but the maturity is declared, resolvable, and anchored so the gate would evaluate it correctly if it ever did.
maturity_ts.prereg_commit_compatibility: prereg_commit._declared_maturity() reads a SCALAR maturity_ts, else the string fields maturity_utc / maturity_iso. This structured object is not a scalar, so the top-level 'maturity_utc' and 'maturity_epoch' fields carry the same instant in the shape that gate can actually evaluate. Verified at build time by calling _declared_maturity() against this artifact.

power_curve.caveat: A result of K < 4 does NOT establish that the model is skilled or validated. The AGAINST test is capable primarily of detecting gross miscalibration.
power_curve.definition: Power = P(K>=4 | all 18 pools independently trap at rate q). This measures the threshold's ability to detect a gross, cohort-wide calibration failure.
power_curve.model: P(K>=4 | Bin(18, q)) - probability that the AGAINST threshold detects a uniform miscalibration where all 18 pools trap at common rate q
power_curve.reprovision: INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED: Binomial(18, q) model. q=0.10 -> P(K>=4|Bin(18,0.10)) = 0.0982 (directive ~0.10); q=0.20 -> P(K>=4|Bin(18,0.20)) = 0.4990 (directive ~0.50); q=0.30 -> P(K>=4|Bin(18,0.30)) = 0.8354 (directive ~0.84).

build_toolchain.reproduction_note: Rebuilding under a different scipy yields identical rounded values (0.0982 / 0.4990 / 0.8354) and a DIFFERENT addendum_hash. A verifier who cannot match the hash should first check scipy's version.
build_toolchain.why_pinned: power_curve.curve.q_*.power (scipy.stats.binom.cdf) and frozen_baseline.independently_verified.HHI (CPython float sum() accumulation) differ in their final ULPs across toolchain versions. Those ULPs do not move any rounded published value but they DO move the canonical JCS hash. Byte-for-byte reproduction of this artifact requires this exact toolchain; the builder refuses to run under any other.

title: XRPL-MC GENESIS ACCEPTANCE STANDARD (DRY-RUN) - founding cohort restricted acceptance

untested.definition: UNTESTED = 0 <= K <= 3 (after INVALID and AGAINST gates)
untested.description: The founding cohort did not produce sufficient evidence to establish either contradiction or predictive skill.
untested.not_evidence_of_support: UNTESTED must NOT be described as evidence supporting the model. It is the residual state after the validated AGAINST threshold.
untested.sui_sol_import_prohibition: Do NOT import the SUI/SOL 0.15-per-pool rule or the 3.45 E-boundary. UNTESTED is purely K-based: 0 <= K <= 3.

verdict_state_machine.evaluation_order: INVALID first (outcome-independent pipeline/integrity check) otherwise AGAINST if K >= 4 realized traps otherwise UNTESTED (0 <= K <= 3).

state_definitions.AGAINST: K >= 4 realized traps. Indicates gross miscalibration, not general predictive failure.
state_definitions.INVALID: A pipeline fault or integrity failure. Not a result about the model. Determined entirely from pre-outcome metadata.
state_definitions.UNTESTED: 0 <= K <= 3 after the INVALID and AGAINST gates. Residual state: insufficient evidence of either contradiction or skill.

prohibited_clauses: any equivalent clause treating K=0 as positive evidence of model skill

rationale.explanation: P(K=0) ranges from 33.8% (rho=0) to 52.5% (rho=0.8) across the tested dependence sensitivity range. Zero traps are a modal/plausible outcome under the frozen prediction distribution and are NOT evidence of predictive skill. This matches the directive's range of 0.34-0.53.

zero_trap_prohibition.sui_import_prohibition: The SUI zero-trap logic (zero_trap_contradiction as EVIDENCE AGAINST) is NOT imported. SUI's P(0 traps) = 0.0021 is below 1%; XRPL-MC's P(0 traps) = 0.3380 is far above any meaningful level.
